ios.desc:
"A new browser with a nice design and advanced features that will appeal to enthusiasts." - LifeHacker

Gear is a modern browser built with powerful web extensions, on-device intelligence, minimal design, and strong privacy protection to provide an exclusive browsing experience and empower productivity.

# Powerful Extension Engine
The first web browser to support both Web Extension and UserScript, designed for high performance and seamlessly integrated with the browser, providing unlimited possibilities.

# Unlimited AI Features
Powered by an on-device large language model, the AI features enhance the browsing experience with groundbreaking privacy protection.

# Adaptive Dark Mode
An advanced intelligent algorithm delivers a refined dark mode with improved visual comfort and better power efficiency.

# Intelligent Translator
Translate web pages with an intelligent engine optimized for accuracy and natural fluency.

# Built-in Content Filter
250,000+ deeply optimized rules to block ads and trackers for faster loading speed and privacy protection.

# Professional Developer Tools
Inspect elements, view resources, analyze performance, and debug with a complete set of on-device developer tools.

# Immersive Reader Mode
Listen, translate, or summarize content with a clean, immersive reading experience.

# Flexible Gear Player
A modern media player with Picture-in-Picture, subtitles, and AirPlay support.

# Designed for the latest iOS Features
Supports the latest iOS features, including default browser, Widgets, Handoff, Spotlight search, and more.
